newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Hing Yiap sees no impact from fire.
newsitem.headline: Hing Yiap sees no impact from fire.

text.p: Hing Yiap Knitting Industries Bhd said that a recent fire at the warehouses of its subsidiary companies would not have a "significant impact" on its business or results for the year ending June 30.
It said in a statement sent late on Thursday to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange that the May 20 fire affected warehouses of its Antioni Sdn Bhd and Bontton Sdn Bhd units.

"The destroyed goods are fully insured and the board has taken immediate remedial action to ensure that the subsidiary companies concerned will have an uninterrupted supply of goods...," the statement said.
Hing Yiap said the operations of the companies "are already in place to continue its business as usual." It did not provide a damage cost.
The property and textile knitting firm also asked the stock exchange to lift the suspension in its stock. Shares of the company last closed at 7.95 ringgit on May 20.
